caption: A blue Citi promotional advertisement shows a soccer scene on the left, with a male player in a light blue shirt and black shorts kicking a ball in a stadium filled with spectators. On the right, large white text reads “Celebrate the game with Coca-Cola” and promotes “up to 18.3% fuel savings” plus gifts at Esso. A soccer ball graphic appears near the text. A boxed section displays an April offer for a free Coca-Cola 4-slim-can pack and a May offer for six Coca-Cola contour glasses, with small product images. The image shows the lower legs and feet of a person standing against a pale green background. The person is wearing glossy red open-toe high-heeled shoes, and a yellow Burger King paper crown is positioned around the lower legs near the ankles, with the Burger King logo prominently displayed on the front. The crown has blue edging, decorative points, and smaller Burger King logos near the top. Text sections labeled “Background & Mission,” “Idea,” and “Result” explain the campaign. A storyboard shows a bus radio ad, sound recognition, coffee aroma release, people smelling it, and a store visit. Photos show a coffee cup, equipment, buses, a storefront, and several people, including a smiling woman holding a cup. Visible results mention 350,000 people, 16% more visitors, and 29% higher sales.

A red and orange promotional graphic shows a large bowl of salad on the right, filled with lettuce, grilled chicken strips, corn, black beans, tortilla strips, and lime wedges. Behind it are black decorative swirls and silhouettes, with faint background images including a runner sign, a bicycle sign, a compass, a flower, a bird, and chili peppers. The image shows a blue-toned advertisement-style scene featuring three blue Pepsi cans arranged in the center against a dark blue gradient background. The front can is largest and fully visible, with the Pepsi globe logo and vertical white “pepsi” text on it, while two similar cans stand partly behind it on the left and right. Near the bottom center, white text reads “REFRESH YOUR WORLD” followed by the Pepsi wordmark.

A mostly white advertisement-style image shows a clear plastic bottle labeled “ethos WATER” tilted diagonally from the upper left, with blue water pouring from its open mouth into a large light-blue heart shape on the right. The heart contains water-like textures, bubbles, and darker blue streaks, with a few droplets below it. A small green circular Starbucks logo appears in the top-right corner. The image is a promotional-style graphic featuring various McDonald’s food items arranged along the bottom against a light gray background.
